checks.description: Require exactly picorv32.v and reject additions, deletions, renames, read-only drift, symlinks, oversized files, evaluator paths, and generated artifacts.
Validate the picorv32 module, frozen values, ordinary ports, required auxiliary module declarations, and the exact 29-port RISCV_FORMAL projection; the structural gate does not prove RVFI semantics.
Elaborate and lint the frozen top_large-derived configuration with content-addressed open tools.

The shared task-neutral Yosys internal-name runner remains a conservative diagnostic: identity passes and one functional mutant fails equivalence on SERVER26, while a retained 32-step mutant probe timed out. It is not sufficient as the sole QoR gate because legal implementation-private rewrites can change matched internal signals.

Compare only top-level outputs for ten symbolic steps under the declared one-cycle active-low reset and zero-state projection. Identity and one structurally changed correct candidate pass; four of five behavior mutants are killed and compile, missing-tool, and timeout controls fail closed, while the retained IRQ mutant false-pass keeps this bounded gate explicitly partial and unfrozen.

Run a small independently written four-instruction program covering reset, native instruction fetch, arithmetic, and one full-word data store with an exact pass sentinel; compressed, multiply, IRQ, and PCPI coverage remains planned.
Confirm generic synthesis completes and emit diagnostic structural statistics without a physical PPA or improvement claim.

excluded_claims: The visible runner, parser, and result schema remain development artifacts; its ordinary-build suite records one baseline positive and eleven fail-closed controls, while the separate RISCV_FORMAL structural suite records one baseline positive and four fail-closed controls, but no structurally distinct correct alternate or independent freeze exists.
No visible check establishes hidden F2P/P2P, ISA compliance, complete formal equivalence, physical timing, physical area, power, performance, QoR, score, or benchmark PASS.
Hidden evaluator and PPA assets are not exposed.
